capabilities: Track tasks through a seven-tab lifecycle (in progress, planned, knowledge base, history)
Generate recurring tasks from daily to yearly templates
Show progress statistics and completed-task history
Warn about task limits and alert on deadlines
extras: Documentation is split across linked pages (home page, task lifecycle, statistics, periodic tasks, configuration); a Russian-language version is available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structured system for planning and tracking personal or professional development tasks over time.
summary: Task manager that organizes personal development tasks in a seven-tab interface with lifecycle tracking, statistics, deadline alerts and recurring task generation.
